name: CommunicationPreference
description: A contact's opt-in or opt-out for a channel and topic, kept for anti-spam compliance.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Surrogate key of the communication preference.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Channel, such as email or sms.

attributes.name: topic
attributes.description: Topic, such as promotions or order-updates.

attributes.name: optedIn
attributes.description: Whether the contact agreed to receive it.

attributes.name: changedAt
attributes.description: When the preference was last set.

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: Where it was set, such as portal or phone.
